attributes.readMe:
## Vendor Onboarding App (VO)

The buyer's intake console: all Vendor Profiles laid out as a vetting pipeline (intake → under review → approved → onboarded, rejected parked below), compliance state visible on every card, click-to-open everywhere. Composes existing blocks UNCHANGED — VendorProfile carries the data and the Onboard action (OnboardVendorCommand); this app only live-queries and arranges.

### Example

The linked instance shows Acme Supply (onboarded, compliant) and Norvik Ltd (approved but award-blocked on a lapsed ISO 9001).

### Non-goals

No vendor-facing signup or portal (single-persona rule). No approval workflow of its own — status transitions happen on the profile and through OnboardVendorCommand, never from this shell.
